units.source_text: 花散里所居东北一区中，有清凉的泉水，种的都是绿树浓荫的夏木。

en.t: In the northeastern quarter where Hanachirusato lived, there was a cool spring, and all the trees planted there were summer trees casting deep green shade.

units.source_text: 窗前更种淡竹，其下凉风习习。

en.t: In front of the windows, pale bamboo had also been planted, and beneath it a cool breeze softly stirred.

units.source_text: 树木都很高大，有如森林。

en.t: All the trees were tall and large, making the place seem like a forest.

units.source_text: 四周围着水晶花篱垣，有如山乡。

en.t: A crystal-flower hedge enclosed it on every side, giving it the air of a mountain village.

units.source_text: 院内种着“今我思畴昔”的橘花、瞿麦花、蔷薇花、牡丹花等种种夏花，其间又杂植春秋的花木。

en.t: In the garden grew many kinds of summer flowers, including orange blossoms called Now I Remember the Past, pinks, roses, and peonies, while flowers and trees of spring and autumn were planted among them as well.

units.source_text: 这一区的东部是马场殿，院内建有跑马场，围以栅栏，以供五月赛马之用。

en.t: The eastern part of this quarter was the riding hall; within the grounds a racecourse had been built and fenced off for the horse races held in the fifth month.
Thickly growing irises were planted by the water.

units.source_text: 对面筑着马厩，其中饲养着盖世无匹的骏马。

en.t: Across from it stood the stables, where peerless fine horses were kept.
